data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve daily AI-visibility metrics for Looker Studio
data.description_suggestion: Fetches daily AI-visibility metric rows for the workspace across a specified date range, segmented by date, brand, AI model, and prompt type. data.current_description: Starts a prospect-report scan headlessly from an agency's own site or app. Requires an API key with the explicit write:prospect-scans scope and an Agency plan with white-label enabled. Scans consume the same quota pool as the dashboard. A repeat request for the same target inside the 7-day dedupe window returns the existing scan with cached true and consumes nothing. data.description_suggestion: Starts a headless prospect-report scan from an agency's white-label site or app. Requires an API key with write:prospect-scans scope and an Agency plan with white-label enabled. If webhook_url is provided, webhooks fire only for newly-created scans; cached responses are returned inline or must be polled via getProspectScan. Returns 200 for cached results or 202 for newly-accepted scans.

data.current_description: Starts a prospect-report scan headlessly from an agency's own site or app. Requires an API key with the explicit write:prospect-scans scope and an Agency plan with white-label enabled. Scans consume the same quota pool as the dashboard. A repeat request for the same target inside the 7-day dedupe window returns the existing scan with cached true and consumes nothing. If webhook_url is supplied, the webhook fires only for scans this request actually creates — cached responses carry the answer inline or are polled.
data.description_suggestion: Starts a headless prospect-report scan from an agency's white-label site or app. Requires an API key with write:prospect-scans scope and an Agency plan with white-label enabled. Scans consume quota from the same pool as dashboard scans. Repeat requests for the same target within 7 days return the cached scan with cached=true and consume no quota. If webhook_url is provided, webhooks fire only for newly-created scans; cached responses are returned inline or must be polled via getProspectScan. Returns 200 for cached results or 202 for newly-accepted scans.
data.reasoning: Description covers prerequisites and deduplication logic well, but lacks clarity about response codes and their meanings. AI agents need to understand that 202 indicates async processing while 200 indicates immediate/cached results. Added explicit response code context and clarified polling behavior for better agent interpretability.
